## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive; confirmed by broad sector participation and cyclicals leading (Industrials/Energy) but tempered by major short-term divergences in a few large caps — watch for follow-through.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Industrials lead: DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND, GE (1W: +9.69% | 1M: +7.76%) ABOVE TREND. Technology strength concentrated in semicap names: AMAT (1W: +14.45% | 1M: +15.56%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +7.24%) ABOVE TREND. Energy strong via OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Materials weak: NUE (1W: -4.66% | 1M: -0.12%) BELOW TREND, DOW (1W: -6.52% | 1M: +7.43%) CORRECTION. Consumer Staples mixed/soft: EL (1W: +7.34% | 1M: -3.09%) RECOVERY, MDLZ (1W: -4.95% | 1M: +2.53%) CORRECTION. Large-cap Tech uneven with several mega-caps BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: AMAT (1W: +14.45% | 1M: +15.56%) ABOVE TREND; SHOP (1W: +14.04% | 1M: -8.91%) RECOVERY; OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND; DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND; GE (1W: +9.69% | 1M: +7.76%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Moderate (3 sectors in Top 5: Tech, Industrials, Energy). Style: Value/Cyclical tilt.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: ETN (1W: -4.34% | 1M: +10.48%) CORRECTION; INTU (1W: -4.37% | 1M: -27.50%) BELOW TREND; NUE (1W: -4.66% | 1M: -0.12%) BELOW TREND; MDLZ (1W: -4.95% | 1M: +2.53%) CORRECTION; INTC (1W: -5.10% | 1M: -18.69%) BELOW TREND.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: AMAT (1W: +14.45% | 1M: +15.56%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +14.04% | 1M: -8.91%) RECOVERY, OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND. Note major short-term divergences among large caps (GOOGL, AMZN, UNH in RECOVERY) — this is a tactical caution despite broad momentum.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed leadership: AMAT (1W: +14.45% | 1M: +15.56%) ABOVE TREND and LRCX (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +7.24%) ABOVE TREND offset by mega-cap weakness — AAPL (1W: +1.09% | 1M: +6.94%) ABOVE TREND and MSFT (1W: -0.92% | 1M: -10.35%) BELOW TREND. Technology showing internal rotation; watch semicap names for continuation.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials constructive with JPM (1W: +2.69% | 1M: +2.90%) ABOVE TREND and momentum in select payments and banks, though V (1W: -1.00% | 1M: -1.13%) and MA (1W: -0.20% | 1M: -0.22%) remain BELOW TREND; sector 1W positive overall.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Mixed/defensive tilt: JNJ (1W: -0.84% | 1M: +11.23%) CORRECTION on strong drug news, UNH (1W: +1.98% | 1M: -16.61%) RECOVERY, LLY (1W: -2.61% | 1M: -6.24%) BELOW TREND — sector breadth modestly positive but watch headline-driven moves.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor cyclical/value exposure into Industrials and Energy names (DE, GE, OXY) and selectively favor AMAT/LRCX among tech suppliers; reduce exposure to structurally weak mega-cap names showing BELOW TREND (MSFT, INTC, ORCL). Given major large-cap divergences, treat recent rebounds in some names as tactical RECOVERY opportunities rather than broad regime confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND; AMAT (1W: +14.45% | 1M: +15.56%) ABOVE TREND; OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: MSFT (1W: -0.92% | 1M: -10.35%) BELOW TREND; INTC (1W: -5.10% | 1M: -18.69%) BELOW TREND; WMT (1W: -7.97% | 1M: +3.04%) CORRECTION.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Industrials and Energy (both showing leadership and earnings/guidance catalysts). BEARISH: Materials and parts of Consumer Staples where weekly weakness contrasts with monthly gains.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: +1.54% | 1M: +3.55%) ABOVE TREND — hold above recent weekly support for broader risk appetite. AAPL (1W: +1.09% | 1M: +6.94%) ABOVE TREND — monitor continuation above monthly pivot. JPM (1W: +2.69% | 1M: +2.90%) ABOVE TREND — breakout above near-term resistance would confirm financial leadership. DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND — watch post-earnings follow-through.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
DE (+80): Deere stock surge on upbeat earnings/guidance; price confirming — DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND. JNJ (+80): FDA breakthrough tag; short-term pullback vs multi-week strength — JNJ (1W: -0.84% | 1M: +11.23%) CORRECTION (news may offer accumulation). LLY (+65): positive trial results but price lagging — LLY (1W: -2.61% | 1M: -6.24%) BELOW TREND (divergence; watch follow-through).

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
BA (-55): Critical NASA report fueling downside and confirming weakness — BA (1W: -3.06% | 1M: -7.21%) BELOW TREND (sentiment confirmed).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON, Value/Cyclical style; Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive and leadership concentrated across Industrials, Energy and select Tech suppliers. DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +14.45% | 1M: +15.56%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +2.69% | 1M: +2.90%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major short-term divergences in large caps (GOOGL, AMZN, UNH in RECOVERY and LLY news vs BELOW TREND) — watch for trend confirmation.
